build_dataset_builder: build a GTZAN dataset builder that downloads and extracts 1000 audio tracks across 10 genres
create_dataset_info: create a GTZAN dataset info with audio features, class labels, and supervised keys
run_split_generators: run GTZAN split generators to download genres.tar.gz and return a single TRAIN split
generate_audio_examples: generate GTZAN examples by walking the genres directory and yielding wav files with genre labels
test_class_labels: test the GTZAN class labels list containing 10 music genres from blues to rock
